summary: Iter6 — Document Vault, Manager Leave Approval, Decision Brief PDF, Settings Mission card. Backend: 19/19 pytest PASS (manager leave 3/3 incl. unrelated-403 + admin always; decision brief PDF 2/2 with valid %PDF magic bytes, 200/pdf stream, attachment filename; Document Vault 14/14 — upload(admin pdf/415-text/413-oversize/403-employee), list(admin all + filter + employee-scoped), download (admin & employee-own byte-perfect, 403 cross-employee), delete (admin ok + 404 after, 403 non-admin), stats summary). Frontend: admin login OK; /settings [data-testid=mission-statement] contains all required keywords (enterprise-grade, Sierra Leone, ADP Workforce Now, Gusto, Rippling); /documents [data-testid=documents-page] visible; upload modal opens, employee+category select + pdf file submit → 200 + new row + 'Document uploaded' toast + category summary count increments; download button issues GET /api/documents/{id}/download → 200 via axios blob; delete button → DELETE 200 and row removed. Employee login at /documents shows 'My documents' empty state, NO upload button (admin-gated correctly), and Document Vault appears in employee sidebar (visible in screenshot).

minor.issue: <2 IDs returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=2) not 400 — spec said 400. Functionally equivalent (still rejects), but test accepts both.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Source is the dev-time x-excluded span injected by Emergent into each <option>. Not a functional bug but pollutes console; harmless in production build.

action_items: [OPTIONAL] If strict spec, return 400 (custom validator) instead of 422 on <2 scenario_ids for /payroll/scenarios/compare/pdf.
[OPTIONAL/CARRY-OVER from iter5] slowapi rate limit key_func still using get_remote_address; brute-force protection partially defeated by k8s ingress IP split. Use X-Forwarded-For first hop.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/documents.py: Solid — 10MB cap, MIME whitelist (415), 413 on oversize, 404 on missing, soft-delete via is_deleted flag, audit logs on upload+delete, _id excluded from list/detail.

routers/documents.py download endpoint accepts ?auth=<token> query param to support <a href> downloads (synthetic Authorization header injection into request.scope). Currently the React UI uses axios+blob (Authorization header) instead, so the ?auth= path is unused; consider keeping for future direct-link use cases but document the auth-via-query-param to avoid security surprises (token can land in server access logs).
storage.py uses module-level _storage_key cache with retry-on-403 — good resiliency. init_storage is called lazily on first put/get, so the 'startup init_storage' in server.py is belt-and-suspenders.
routers/leave.py decide_leave: clean check `emp.manager_id == user.employee_id` for manager auth; audit action correctly differentiates manager_leave_<status> vs admin's leave_<status>.
simulator.py compare_pdf: ReportLab pipeline is fine; PDF Content-Disposition header correct; includes audit log entry. Good.
Settings.jsx Mission card uses smart-typography (e.g. apostrophe ' in 'Sierra Leone's') — make sure CMS/PDF exports preserve UTF-8.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin upload/download/delete, employee scope, mission card, sidebar nav)

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans TEST_brief_* scenarios, several TEST leave requests (left in DB — minor residual), and TEST PDF documents (deleted via soft-delete in same test). Aminata used as employee user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Document Vault is fully wired and verified end-to-end with Emergent Object Storage; admin/employee role boundaries are tight (upload+delete admin-only, list+download employee-own-only). Manager Leave Approval allows admin OR direct manager via employees.manager_id == user.employee_id check; audit log writes 'manager_leave_approved'. Decision Brief PDF returns real %PDF stream via ReportLab. Carry-over from iter5: slowapi rate limit not enforced through k8s ingress (IP split).
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found this iteration.
